method: 5000 quasi-uniform directions: y=1-2*(i+0.5)/5000; angle=i*2.399963229728653; xz radius=sqrt(1-y*y). Select moonResources copper fraction>=0.7, place at canonical surface+1.75m, query nearbySurfaceDeposits radius400m.
scope: Sampled coverage, not an exhaustive bound for every slope or province boundary.
